note: Published paths never move: global-law mounts this repo at france/national/acts and its case-law overlays key on these paths. New sources land in new top-level folders.

folders.holds: Constitution of 1958 (and the 1946/1848 articles LEGI keeps in force), every article version
the 77 codes consolidated by LEGI, one file per article, every version
every other consolidated text (lois, ordonnances, décrets, arrêtés…)
texts as published in the Journal officiel (Lois et Décrets), unconsolidated; nominative measures as metadata only
national collective agreements, every article version
legislative files, texts adopted, amendments, votes
index of the case-law repositories (decisions are kept in lexifina/france-<court>-caselaw)
folders.source: DILA CASS, INCA, CAPP, JADE, CONSTIT

folders.holds: acts of local authorities that publish them as open data
folders.source: INSEE COG 2026, data.gouv.fr (SCDL délibérations), official local publishers
